changelog: v1 (2026-08-11): raw-verified filter = type in {article,rapid,brief,letter}; journal != PHYSICS; DOI != 10.1103/PhysRev.75.1614.2; title-prefix/exact exclusion. corpus 745,889 / gold 205,243.

v2 (2026-08-12): added PhySH guard to the title heuristic -- a record carrying PhySH classification is never excluded by title. Restores 5 research papers the prefix rules caught by accident ('Correction to the energy spectrum...', 'Retraction dynamics of...droplets...', etc.), all of which are in the released benchmark gold set. corpus 745,894 / gold 205,248; needing and 2016 cohort unchanged. Released gold (197,167) is now a strict subset of canonical gold.

v3 (2026-08-12): every title-flagged record (93) reviewed individually from title and abstract, per PI direction that exclusion must mean genuinely non-research. 43 are non-research (27 front matter/errata/publisher's notes/editorials/announcements + 16 comment-reply correspondence addressing a specific publication) and stay excluded; 50 are genuine research papers and are kept (24 'Correction to...' research papers, 19 topic-style 'Comment on the...' research notes, the 1893 'Note.' proof, 1 'Reply'-titled... none -- plus the 5 label-bearing papers of v2). Corpus 745,894 -> 745,939. The v2 PhySH-guard rule is superseded by the reviewed per-record table below; gold, 2016 cohort, and letters unchanged.

v4 (2026-08-12): FINAL. Two closures per PI decision. (a) The 11 records from 2023-2025 that entered the APS files after the production runs are excluded by definition (snapshot boundary; they are expected to carry author labels in APS's current database, which this paper does not use). (b) The 45 reviewed-in research papers without labels were labeled with the released prompt by five independent frontier-model annotator runs (Claude Opus x2, Sonnet x2, Haiku; 15 fresh exemplars per run) and appended to the five run files, one run each. Corpus 745,928 = 205,248 author-labeled + 540,680 model-labeled; coverage complete; no residual. Dual-label cohort for the error analysis = the 17,777 papers of 2016. The public repository is regenerated to carry exactly the corpus-filtered runs.

v5 (2026-08-12): FINAL (supersedes v4). The 11 post-snapshot records are corpus members and were labeled by the same five annotator runs as the 45 reviewed-in papers (56 backfilled in total), so the post-snapshot exclusion is gone and coverage is complete with no residual. Corpus 745,939 = 205,248 author-labeled + 540,691 model-labeled. The dual-label cohort for the S2 error analysis is the 2016 rollout cohort (17,777). Regenerated public run files: 558,952 rows per run (540,691 model-labeled corpus papers + 18,261 papers that also carry author labels, whose author labels take precedence in all analyses).

v6 (2026-08-13): thorough second title pass per PI direction after mock round 10 found 'Important Announcement: Page-Charge Problem' escaping the prefix screen. Keywords searched anywhere in the title; 283 new hits individually reviewed; 31 excluded (see widescan_2026_08_13 and the appended title_review_table rows). Title-review exclusions 43 -> 74; total misclassified 44 -> 75. All 31 are pre-2016 and carry no author labels: gold, the 2016 cohort, and letters are unchanged. known_residuals cleared (176.425 now excluded).
